description: This is a Python source file that implements a repository class for accessing car data stored in a Supabase database. It defines functions to parse and normalize data, and a class `SupabaseCarRepository` that provides methods for listing cars with filters, ordering, and pagination, as well as retrieving a car by ID.

classes.name: SupabaseCarRepository
classes.description: A repository implementation for cars backed by Supabase, providing methods to list cars with filters and retrieve individual cars by ID.
